title: Satellite booth ops mini journal
content:
Purpose:
Quick, portable scratchpad for last-minute admin and expense reminders for the satellite booth at regional events. Not a final SOP — just things I want visible on the fly (phone, receipts, short vendor notes).

At-a-glance travel items:
- Flight: SFO -> SEA, Delta 453, seat 12A (carry-on only). Confirmed + screenshot in travel folder.
- Hotel: Alderpoint Suites (walking distance to venue). Use corporate rate (code REDWOOD23) — check-in after 3pm.
- Local transport: Uber estimate $30-45 one-way; budget shuttle available for staff from 8:00–9:00am.

Vendor & in-person contacts (fast dials / notes):
- AV rental: Nora Patel, SoundWave AV — nora@soundwaveav.com, +1-415-555-0162. Keep quote ref # SW-187. Ask for morning mic test and 1 spare lapel battery.
- Furniture/booth drayage: Mateo Ruiz, BoothLift, mateo@boothlift.io, +1-206-555-0135. Confirm arrival window (THU 08:00–10:00). Delivery contact prefers text.
- Shipping/receipts: Event FedEx account — ship to: Alderpoint Suites, c/o Events Desk. Save tracking numbers for reimbursement.
- Badge printing / lead retrieval: Onsite kiosk (kiosk-3). If kiosk down, use paper signup (form link in travel folder).

Expense reminders (reimbursement rules and quick examples):
- Save receipts for every purchase > $10 (meals, taxis, AV add-ons). Photos + expense form required.
- Per-diem: domestic standard $60/day (breakfast/lunch/dinner combined). If meal charged to company card, note which person and reason.
- Card usage: company card only for AV/freight/large booth items. Personal card for incidental expenses (taxi, coffee) then file for reimbursement.
- Taxis/rideshares: capture trip receipt (screenshots accepted). For pooled trips, include names of passengers.
- Currency: venue is USD. If local vendor charges in USD card fee shows — include conversion fee in receipt notes if any.

Receipts capture checklist (what I actually check before upload):
- Merchant name visible
- Amount and date match credit card statement
- Items or brief description on longer receipts (e.g., "AV " or "Furniture delivery")
- If tipping, line item or handwritten note included
- Photo of receipt + photo of package label for shipped items

Onsite quick ops to-dos (ordered):
1) Confirm AV arrival window with Nora by 10:00am WED before the event. If not confirmed, escalate to Liam.
2) Confirm BoothLift delivery ETA and unloading location (map in travel folder).
3) Drop off two spare business cards with front desk (for walk-ups).
4) Print 10 paper sign-up forms and 1 clipboard. If kiosk works, use lead retrieval app; fallback is paper.
5) Test Wi-Fi tether from phone; bring travel hotspot device.
6) Label all boxes with brown kraft tape and our short name "RWD-INF" + phone number for retrieval.

Notes on reimbursement process (personal reminders):
- Use expense form template: Expenses > New > Tag as "event-satellite-SEA-02-2026".
- Attach receipts (photo + PDF when available).
- Put vendor invoice PDF in linked Confluence under attached files.
- Keep a personal copy of receipts until reimbursement cleared (usually 2–3 pay cycles for external vendor invoices).

Fallbacks / gotchas I've seen:
- If AV goes over quote, ask for itemized list before approving. Quick approve only for labor if within $150 cap.
- If BoothLift arrives early and wants to drop boxes in lobby, insist on loading dock per contract to avoid extra handling fees.
- Onsite badge kiosks sometimes require browser refresh — carry a laptop with Chrome + incognito.

To-do (notes to self):
- [ ] Confirm final headcount for staff shirts by Feb 20 (current: 6).
- [ ] Add Mateo's updated quote to expense folder and request corrected invoice number.
- [ ] Print one laminated emergency contact card per staffer (POC + corporate card last 4).
- [ ] Pack extra marker pens, gaffer tape, and USB-C charging hub.

Quick templates (copy-paste-ready):
- Email to vendor to confirm ETA:
  "Hi Nora — quick confirmation of AV arrival window for Redwood satellite booth at Alderpoint on Thu. Could you confirm delivery ETA and if you can do a mic check at 8:30am? Ref SW-187. Thanks, Jordan."

- Expense note example for taxi reimbursement:
  "Taxi SFO -> Alderpoint Suite, 2026-02-18, $48.50. Travelling for regional satellite booth setup. Passenger: Jordan Matthews. Receipt attached (screenshot)."

Unresolved / open questions to follow up on:
- Do we have an on-site storage locker available for spare posters? (Slacked venue team; awaiting reply).
- Can accounting pre-approve a $200 contingency charge on the company card for last-minute AV needs?

Misc personal bits (scratchpad):
- Bring earplugs — loud halls.
- Charge battery pack fully before leaving hotel.
- Double-check dietary restrictions for staff dinner: Priya = vegetarian, Liam = pescatarian.

Last-minute contact list (save to phone):
- Jordan Matthews (me): +1-415-555-0199 (mobile)
- Priya Nair: +1-650-555-0127 (mobile)
- Liam O'Connor: +1-206-555-0177 (mobile)
- Nora (SoundWave AV): +1-415-555-0162
- Mateo (BoothLift): +1-206-555-0135

End of scratchpad — will refine into formal ops checklist if items repeat across events.

Notes to self: Keep this doc lightweight; snapshot into events SOP after the show.
